title: Canadian Defence Hardware Program
description: Eleven hands-on hardware builds across sky, water, and ground, each mapped to a stated Defence Drone Initiative or Army MINERVA requirement - full BOMs, prices, step-by-step build guides, and bench photos.

title: Sky: Passive Aerial Early-Warning Node
description: Receive-only passive radar on a KrakenSDR 5-channel coherent SDR: FM/TV broadcast reflections off aircraft, range-Doppler processing with pyAPRiL, scored against an RTL-SDR ADS-B ground-truth receiver.

title: Water: Passive Acoustic Vessel Monitor
description: Solar-powered hydrophone node classifying passing vessels from underwater sound, with an RTL-SDR AIS receiver as ground truth and a dock-to-recharge extension.

title: Ground: Seismic & Acoustic Perimeter Mesh
description: Solar 915 MHz LoRa mesh of ESP32 nodes with ADXL355 accelerometers and geophones, classifying vehicles vs footsteps vs wind at the edge and reporting signed detections.

title: GPS-Denied Navigation Rover
description: ROS 2 rover fusing wheel odometry, BNO085 IMU, and 2D LiDAR with an Extended Kalman Filter; GNSS gets switched off and position drift is measured against a u-blox ground-truth track.

title: Convoy-Following Robots on a Degraded Mesh
description: Two rovers convoy behind a lead vehicle over a 915 MHz LoRa / Wi-Fi mesh, hold formation through induced link drops, and recover on reconnect - the resupply-convoy DDIL problem at bench scale.

title: Passive Acoustic Drone Detector
description: MEMS microphone array on a Raspberry Pi detecting rotor harmonics, rejecting birds and aircraft, and estimating direction of arrival by beamforming - emits nothing, only detects.

title: Thermal Search-and-Rescue Drone
description: X500-class quadcopter with a FLIR Lepton thermal camera and Hailo AI HAT+ edge detection finding people in snow and brush, pushing georeferenced detections to a live map.

title: Cold-Soak Battery Characterization Rig
description: Heated, instrumented drone battery bay tested in a lab freezer and real Canadian winter - runtime, voltage sag, and failure modes logged against temperature as a published dataset.

title: Secure Robot-Fleet Updates
description: Secure boot, TPM 2.0 measured boot, YubiKey-signed OTA updates, and automatic A/B rollback for the robot fleet - validated in a cold chamber and under power-cut chaos tests.

title: Mini Airspace Deconfliction Manager
description: ESP32 tracker beacons plus ArduPilot SITL simulated drones, dynamic 3D geofences, predicted-conflict alerts, and a human-in-the-loop override for every resolution.

title: Multi-Domain Common Operating Picture
description: The fusion layer tying every sensor build together: signed detections over MQTT/Zenoh, store-and-forward through dead links, a Kalman-filter tracker fusing air, water, and ground tracks, and a human making every decision.

title: Arctic Domain Awareness Digital Twin
description: Streaming pipeline fusing open ADS-B aircraft data, AIS ship tracking, and Sentinel-1 radar imagery over Canada's North, flagging dark vessels and route deviations. Relevant to NORAD modernization and Arctic sovereignty.

title: DDIL-Proof DevOps
description: CI/CD and telemetry that keep working through denied, degraded, intermittent, and limited links: store-and-forward, delta updates, signed artifacts, k3s edge nodes, chaos-tested with tc netem.

title: Counter-Drone Sensor Fusion Simulator
description: Synthetic radar, RF, acoustic, and camera tracks fused with Kalman filters, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop alert triage. Defensive, simulation only.

title: Decision Black Box
description: Tamper-evident audit layer for human-in-the-loop decisions: hash-chained signed append-only log, replay tool, and OPA policy-as-code checks.

title: Zero-Trust Air-Gapped Software Supply Chain
description: SBOM, sigstore signing, and reproducible builds moved across a simulated one-way transfer into an offline registry, mapped to Canadian Centre for Cyber Security guidance.

title: Operation LENTUS-Style Disaster Response Drone Mapping
description: Simulated drone flights mapping floods and wildfires, edge computer vision detecting affected areas, and a live situational-awareness map, with OR-Tools route optimization.

title: Homelab Server Room
description: The cozy basement server room behind everything on this site: racked desktop and laptop Proxmox hosts, managed switching with VLAN trunking, wireless backhaul, power, and cooling.

title: Kubernetes Infrastructure
description: Production-grade multi-node K8s cluster across 7 machines with VLAN segmentation, Calico CNI, MetalLB, Longhorn storage, and Prometheus + Grafana observability.

title: TYF-AI - Self-Hosted Local AI Security Platform
description: Hardened local AI inference: llama.cpp with CUDA, Open WebUI behind an authenticated Caddy proxy, per-model Firejail sandboxing, and GPU passthrough on Proxmox.

title: Proxmox VE Zero-Trust Private Cloud
description: 3-node Proxmox HA cluster with Ceph, VLAN segmentation, and zero public ingress via Cloudflare Tunnel with Tailscale fallback and automated ZFS snapshots.

title: Data Sovereignty & Secure Media Stack
description: Self-hosted Nextcloud + Immich on BTRFS external SSDs with multi-user ACL isolation and a 3-2-1 offsite backup pipeline to BorgBase and rsync.net.

title: Chakor - Self-Hosted AI Workspace
description: Open-source AI workspace you run yourself. Local and cloud models, web search, document chat, model compare, notes, and memory - all private on your hardware.

title: Private AI Model
description: Self-hosted LLM with integrated web search at ai.tyfsadik.org. Full privacy, no cloud subscriptions.

title: Proxmox Homelab
description: Full virtualization stack for testing servers, VMs, containers, and network configurations.

title: Self-Hosted DNS
description: Network-wide ad/tracker blocking with Pi-hole and recursive DNS resolution via Unbound.

title: Private Email Server
description: Self-hosted SMTP/IMAP with Postfix + Dovecot on custom domain @tyfsadik.org.

title: Self-Hosted Cloud Storage
description: Private Nextcloud instance replacing Google Drive. Syncs files across all devices.

title: Self-Hosted Photo Server
description: Personal photo management with ML face recognition and mobile auto-backup.

title: Public Search Engine
description: Privacy-respecting search engine aggregating results from multiple sources without tracking.

title: Public Wiki Server
description: Full Wikipedia mirror accessible to users in countries with restricted internet access.

title: Arch Linux Remote Desktop via WSL2
description: Full Arch Linux + XFCE remote desktop via WSL2 - no router port forwarding required.

title: HomeBound Aisha
description: Business website for a home-based service provider. Responsive, client-delivered.

title: GTA High Glass
description: Website for a glass and glazing company in the Greater Toronto Area.

title: Hakimi Fruits
description: Online presence for a fruit and produce business with product listings.

title: Faiaz Shisha
description: Multi-page website for a shisha lounge with flavour menu and booking info.

title: Pharmacy Website
description: Medical/pharmacy website with product listings and service information.

title: Birthday Project
description: Interactive birthday celebration page with CSS animations and JavaScript effects.

title: Practice Apps
description: TypeScript and web development practice projects (app_2_kimi, heda1, heda2).

title: Depot Gato
description: 2D tower defense game with wave spawning, placement mechanics, and pixel art assets.

title: GateArch
description: Student portal and admin system with course management and user authentication.

title: TaxGlobe
description: Web application for calculating taxes across different jurisdictions with clear breakdowns.

title: Wonder Learning
description: E-learning platform with course listings, video embeds, and educational interface.

title: Arctic ISR Drone
description: Build guide for a cold-weather ISR drone against the MINERVA Arctic UAS spec: heated battery bay with cold-soak data, Lepton thermal detection measured in pixels-on-target, detections georeferenced into TAK, and glove-operable controls.

title: GPS-Denied Cargo Ground Vehicle for Snow
description: Build guide for a GPS-denied cargo UGV testbed: LiDAR-inertial odometry with snow filtering, EKF slip handling, payload and energy sweeps, RTK as ground truth only, against the MINERVA ground vehicle specs.

title: Autonomous Seabed-Survey Boat
description: Build guide for an autonomous survey USV: ArduPilot Rover lawnmower lines, Ping echosounder depth logs, gridded seabed models, and anomaly detection scored against planted targets.

title: Counter-Drone Test-and-Scoring Harness
description: Build guide for a counter-drone sensor scoring harness: SAPIENT (BSI Flex 335) node interfaces, a TAK bridge, YAML scenario cards, Stone Soup metrics, a Monte Carlo coverage planner, and fleet ops.

title: Secure Autonomy for the Robot and Drone Fleet
description: Build guide for fleet hardening: STRIDE threat model, MAVLink 2 signing, Ed25519 signed firmware, SROS2 enclaves, WireGuard links, a pymavlink IDS, and signed A/B updates, attacked in the lab first.

title: Sovereign AI and Data Enclave
description: Build guide for a security-controlled private AI enclave on the Chakor stack: Keycloak identity, OPA and OpenTDF policy, HSM-backed OpenBao keys, label-filtered pgvector retrieval, and tamper-evident audit.
